question: Can an additive portable C11 owner reproduce apply_command_guard and compose its actual proposed outputs through existing native pedal, normalized-clock and recovery/final gates without the external Python base-guard result?
source_owner: reference/command_guard.py apply_command_guard; existing Python semantics remain unchanged
domain: Offline proposed-control records over four synthetic slots, not confirmed motors or a physical wheel mapping.

Direct Python/C parity is restricted to exact CommandGuardConfig/Input/State records, exact AllocationResult candidates (or candidates deliberately encoded as invalid), ordinary int/float scalars converted to binary64, ordinary list/tuple length4 vectors and bounded existing text/enum conventions.

Numeric subclasses/custom conversion hooks, Python duck-typed outer records, arbitrary-precision values not convertible to finite binary64, unbounded/NUL-containing text, and unbounded raw Python state/counter domains are not newly claimed as representable.
Representable NaN/Inf, Boolean/nonnumeric tags, wrong vector shape tags, malformed Boolean bytes, invalid statuses, contradictions and allocation-contract violations are explicit rejection cases.
New C-only outer schema tags/null pointers have deterministic fail-closed semantics but are not misrepresented as Python result parity where Python raises instead of producing a result.

api.version: Separate base-command-guard semantic/layout version1; existing torque ABI1/numeric contract2 and prior clock/pedal versions remain unchanged.
api.input: tc_command_guard_input: type_valid; tc_scalar dt_s,accelerator; uint8 brake,comms,sensors,interlock
api.result: tc_command_guard_result: tc_guard guard; tc_command_guard_state next; uint32 contract_code (0 before validation or on contract success)
api.initial_state: Non-NULL initializer writes valid type/vector/numeric tags, four positive zero previous outputs, latchfalse. NULL initializer is a no-op.
api.pointer_contract: Aligned complete objects, input/output storage mutually non-overlapping; no heap allocation. Required NULL returns1; any available result is initialized inhibited with four positive zeros and valid zero next-state/latchtrue, reason invalid_argument. Non-NULL calls return0 even when inhibited.
api.c_only_outer_schema_order: After required pointers: invalid state.type_valid -> invalid_guard_state_type/latchtrue; malformed latch -> Python invalid_pedal_latch_state/latchtrue; invalid config.type_valid at config stage -> invalid_guard_config_type/preserve valid prior latch; invalid input.type_valid after previous-vector checks -> invalid_guard_input_type/preserve prior latch.

exact_base_fault_precedence: Config max-rise: finite ordinary numeric and >0, else invalid_max_rise_rate.
Config trip/clear: both finite ordinary numeric and0<=clear<trip<=1, else invalid_pedal_threshold.
Previous vector: ordinary length4, each finite ordinary numeric >=0, else invalid_previous_output.
Input dt: finite ordinary numeric >0, else invalid_dt.
Input accelerator: finite ordinary numeric in[0,1], else invalid_accelerator_fraction.
All four Boolean fields must be exactBoolean bytes0/1, else invalid_boolean_input.
Existing tc_validate_allocation, preserving its current ordered contract code and tc_contract_reason.
Then and only then evolve base latch: priortrue clears when accel<=clear; priorfalse trips when brake&&accel>=trip.
Valid allocator fault -> allocator_fault; then external_interlock_open; critical_communication_loss; sensor_disagreement; brake_accelerator_overlap.
Compute rounded binary64 max_step=rise*dt. Nonfinite -> invalid_rise_step.
All inhibit paths produce exact positive-zero output and previous-output vector immediately, preserving the appropriate evolved/prior latch.
exact_slew_and_status: For each slot in fixed order: target<=previous -> command=target immediately; otherwise command=min(target,previous+max_step).
max_step underflow to0 is finite and remains source-compatible. previous+max_step overflow to+Inf is allowed because finite target wins the min; do not invent a new inhibit.
Preserve the source's rate label test commanded<target-1e-12 exactly; it is an existing diagnostic threshold, not a newly selected physical torque margin.
Statuslimited iff allocationstatussaturated or source rate_limited. Reasons exactly aggregate_and_rise_rate_limit / aggregate_limit / rise_rate_limit / None.
Valid negative-zero target values remain source-compatible; inhibited outputs specifically require positive zero bits.
No new allocator, aggregate cap, traction allocation, sensor calibration, continuous-time interpolation, transport, motor-enable or hardware policy.

composition.scope: New offline parity runner orchestrates actual compiled C base guard plus existing C pedal adapter, clock and final gate; no claim of a fully native scheduler/allocator/pipeline.
order: On valid restart, zero previous proposed output before C base guard and preserve pedal latch; clock anchor is not reset.
Use already computed external allocation as the shared candidate. Call new C base guard, then existing trusted overlap/clear reconciliation; use actual C-produced vectors/status/reason/latch.
Observe existing native normalized clock. Clock faults retain prior latch even if base clear was healthy; conservative new trips remain.
Construct final cycle with effective reconciled guard, native clock fault and restart; use existing C final gate/recovery owner.
Next slew history is the actually proposed final command, zero while recovery/inhibit holds. Retain reconciled/clock-qualified latch and native clock/gate state.
source_corner_cases: Base guard can set a pedal latch before a later communication/sensor/interlock inhibit; preserve that behavior.
A valid zero-output allocatorfault can clear the raw base latch at lowpedal; existing trusted-clear adapter restores it on an inhibited cycle.
A trusted overlap can be observed despite invalid dt/interlock or candidate contract, according to the existing narrow helper; base result remains inhibited.
No clock-fault low-pedal cycle may be the sole clearance observation; no invisible slew credit while recovery holds.

build_policy: Additive separate guarded-library build over four C units; existing3unit build helper/old receipts and frozen Cortex-M4 cohort remain untouched.
Strict C11 binary64 static assertions; no fast/finite-only math, no excess precision/reassociation; explicitly disable FP contraction in the new build.

GCC/Clang host builds and ordinary IEEE round-to-nearest semantics only. Retain diagnostics/compiler/version/flags/source/binary hashes; deterministic receipts and repeated binary/behavior signatures.
No new ARM object compilation, linker, firmware, target emulator, CAN, board IO, physical mapping, or actuation.
Ordinary IEEE binary64 round-to-nearest with retained subnormals is an explicit assumption; no changed floating environment, FTZ/DAZ, or MCU runtime behavior is claimed.

planned_verification.direct: Source-grounded ordered-fault cross-products; all valid/inhibited/limited reasons; threshold neighbors, signed/subnormal zeros, DBL_TRUE_MIN/MIN/MAX, NaN/Inf, multiplication overflow/underflow, addition overflow, shape/type/status/fault contradictions.
planned_verification.stateful: Deterministic seeded finite streams including repeated trip/clear, decreases, recovery holds, restart and corrupted inputs; state always compared after each cycle.
planned_verification.composition: Reuse existing source scenario families and add cases closing the external base-guard gap; compare direct base result, adapter result, clock fault/state, recovery snapshot, proposedcommand/reason and next slew/latch history.
planned_verification.abi: Every declared struct size, invalid scalar/vector/status/text and outer tags, all malformed Boolean bytevalues, NULL required pointers, default result initialization and exact-positive-zero inhibits.
planned_verification.sanitizer: New finite C guard probe under actual ASAN+UBSan GCC/Clang×Python3.11/12/13 CI; old probes retained. Push checkpoint CI before draft publication.
planned_verification.review: Independent practical adversarial source/compiled-result review, retained counterexamples before fixes, then source-bound final-head CI handoff.
planned_verification.local_model: No model calls without root GPU/memory coordination. Any later suggestion is only a bounded hypothesis, separately retained and deterministically accepted/rejected.

excluded_claims: Physical motor/wheel order or pedal/sensor provenance
Hardware timing, WCET, complete stack/flash/RAM fit
root_plan_review: Accepted for implementation after final green PR73 ownership handoff; source policy unchanged.
